scenario: 公交清分数仓 · 新票价口径分批上线最小联发名单样例（选择 dws_line_settlement_detail 可看到上下游均被拉入同批）

models.name: dwd_card_transaction_detail
models.description: 【线上版】刷卡交易明细宽表：关联卡信息与线路维度，沿用实扣金额 amount
models.sql: WITH valid_card AS (SELECT ci.card_id AS card_id, ci.card_type AS card_type FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.card_id AS card_id, vc.card_type AS card_type, t.line_id AS line_id, dl.line_name AS line_name, dl.company_id AS company_id, t.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, t.transaction_time AS transaction_time, t.amount AS amount, t.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag FROM ods_card_transaction t INNER JOIN valid_card vc ON t.card_id = vc.card_id INNER JOIN dim_bus_line dl ON t.line_id = dl.line_id WHERE t.city_code = '3301'

models.name: dws_line_settlement_detail
models.description: 【线上版】线路清分明细：按实扣金额 amount 直接生成结算金额 settlement_amount
models.sql: SELECT d.line_id AS line_id, d.line_name AS line_name, d.company_id AS company_id, d.card_type AS card_type, d.transaction_id AS transaction_id, d.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag, d.amount AS settlement_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction_detail d INNER JOIN dim_bus_line l ON d.line_id = l.line_id WHERE l.line_type = 'BUS'

models.name: dws_route_fare_summary
models.description: 【线上版】线路票价汇总：透传上游结算明细列，供公司级报表读取
models.sql: SELECT s.line_id AS line_id, s.line_name AS line_name, s.company_id AS company_id, s.transaction_id AS transaction_id, s.settlement_amount AS total_settlement FROM dws_line_settlement_detail s

models.name: ads_company_settlement_report
models.description: 【线上版】公司级结算报表：读取线路汇总结果
models.sql: SELECT r.company_id AS company_id, r.line_id AS line_id, r.line_name AS line_name, r.total_settlement AS total_settlement FROM dws_route_fare_summary r

models.name: dwd_card_transaction_detail
models.description: 【候选版】新票价口径：关联票价规则维表，新增 fare_amount（规则票价）、base_fare、net_amount（优惠后应收）输出列
models.sql: WITH valid_card AS (SELECT ci.card_id AS card_id, ci.card_type AS card_type FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.card_id AS card_id, vc.card_type AS card_type, t.line_id AS line_id, dl.line_name AS line_name, dl.company_id AS company_id, t.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, t.transaction_time AS transaction_time, t.amount AS amount, t.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag, fr.base_fare AS base_fare, fr.base_fare * fr.discount_rate AS fare_amount, fr.base_fare * fr.discount_rate - t.amount AS net_amount FROM ods_card_transaction t INNER JOIN valid_card vc ON t.card_id = vc.card_id INNER JOIN dim_bus_line dl ON t.line_id = dl.line_id INNER JOIN dim_bus_fare_rule fr ON fr.line_id = t.line_id AND fr.card_type = vc.card_type WHERE t.city_code = '3301'

models.name: dws_line_settlement_detail
models.description: 【候选版】新票价口径：改用上游 fare_amount 计算结算金额，不再透传旧 settlement_amount 写法（输出列改名 fare_settlement_amount）
models.sql: SELECT d.line_id AS line_id, d.line_name AS line_name, d.company_id AS company_id, d.card_type AS card_type, d.transaction_id AS transaction_id, d.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag, d.fare_amount AS fare_settlement_amount, d.net_amount AS net_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction_detail d INNER JOIN dim_bus_line l ON d.line_id = l.line_id WHERE l.line_type = 'BUS'

models.name: dws_route_fare_summary
models.description: 【候选版】新票价口径：改读 fare_settlement_amount，并补充规则票价差额 net_amount 输出
models.sql: SELECT s.line_id AS line_id, s.line_name AS line_name, s.company_id AS company_id, s.transaction_id AS transaction_id, s.fare_settlement_amount AS total_settlement, s.net_amount AS total_net_amount FROM dws_line_settlement_detail s

models.name: ads_company_settlement_report
models.description: 【候选版】公司级结算报表：输出列与读取列均未变化，验证它可以继续留在线上版
models.sql: SELECT r.company_id AS company_id, r.line_id AS line_id, r.line_name AS line_name, r.total_settlement AS total_settlement FROM dws_route_fare_summary r
